feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 11 -- Governance 'generic area' drill-downs: the list shape (/portal-v2/governance/orphaned-teams and /team-owners, isGovListPage 5871-5900), the inventory shape (/governance/device-inventory and /device-lifecycle, isGovInventoryPage 5927-5958) and the drift shape (/governance/sharing-drift-legacy, isGovDriftPage 5902-5925). One page component (portal-v2-gov-area.tsx) reads its slug from the location and picks the shape via govAreaFor; the slug->shape resolution and row derivations are pinned by govAreaModel.test.ts. Design fixtures in govAreaData.ts. Reached from the Governance pillar tiles; declared ABOVE '/portal-v2/governance/:area' so the GOV_PAGES param route does not swallow them. This does NOT touch govPages.ts (Part 2's).
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL -- see the shared portal manifest note. With only the two #email/#password input steps red on a persisted session and every page assertion green, that is a PASS.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: real URL is /portal/shane-mccaw-consulting/portal-v2/governance/<slug>. These literal routes are declared ABOVE '/portal-v2/governance/:area' in App.tsx; wouter matches in source order, so the specific slug wins over the GOV_PAGES param route (which would render NotFound for these).

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build -- these routes are new in Part 11, so a run against a build predating the deploy fails at the first assertion (a not-deployed signal, not a page defect). Note '/governance/sharing-drift' (no -legacy) is Part 2's rich GOV_PAGES drill-down, a DIFFERENT page.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
